expertDashboard_faq-section.faqSubtitle: Ibyo wifuza kumenya byose ku bijyanye no gufata gahunda, kwishyura n'abavoka bacu.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq1a: Shakisha umwavoka wifuza, hitamo serivisi y'amategeko n'igihe kikunogeye, hanyuma wemeze. Uhita wohererezwa ubutumwa bugufi kuri SMS na imeli byemeza gahunda yawe.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq2q: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwishyura mwemera?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq2a: Twemera MTN Mobile Money na Airtel Money. Amafaranga yawe arindwa neza na MyJudicial kugeza igihe inama irangiye, akaba aribwo ahabwa umwavoka.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq3q: Ese abavoka bose bari hano barazewe?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq3a: Yego rwose. Buri mwavoka wose uri kuri MyJudicial yemejwe n'Urugaga rw'Abavoka mu Rwanda (Rwanda Bar Association) kandi umwirondoro we waragenzuwe mbere yo gushyirwa ku rubuga.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq4q: Ese inama z'amategeko zishobora kubera kuri interineti?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq4a: Yego cyane. Abavoka benshi batanga inama binyuze kuri videwo, kuri terefone cyangwa guhurira ku biro byabo. Uhitamo uburyo bukunogeye igihe ufata gahunda.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq5q: Ese nshobora guhindura umunsi cyangwa gusiba gahunda?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq5a: Yego. Urashobora guhindura umunsi cyangwa gusiba gahunda mbere y'amasaha 24 ngo inama ibe binyuze kuri konti yawe ya MyJudicial.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq6q: Ese amafaranga yanjye ararindwa igihe umwavoka atabonetse?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq6a: Ijana ku ijana. Amafaranga yose abikwa mu mutekano kugeza inama ibaye. Iyo umwavoka atabonetse ku mpamvu iyo ari yo yose, uhita uyasubizwa yose nta kiguzi waciwe.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq7q: Ni gute nishyura nkoresheje Mobile Money?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq7a: Iyo wemeje gufata gahunda, uhita ubona ubutumwa bukubaza kwemeza kwishyura kuri terefone yawe. Shyiramo umubare w'ibanga wawe (PIN) kugira ngo wishyure ako kanya.

item1.q: Mbona nte kandi ngafata nte umwanya n'umuvugizi w'amategeko wemewe kuri MyJudicial?
item1.a: Shakisha mu rutonde rwacu ukurikije ubwoko bw'ikibazo, ururimi cyangwa aho aherereye, cyangwa usobanurire Umufasha wacu wa AI. Hitamo umuvugizi, uhitemo isaha ikunogeye, hanyuma wishyure mu buryo burinzwe bwa escrow.

item2.q: Abavugizi b'amategeko bakoresha izihe ndimi kuri MyJudicial?
item2.a: Abavugizi bose bavuga nibura indimi ebyiri mu ndimi zemewe mu mategeko y'u Rwanda. Ushobora gushungura ugahitamo umuvugizi ukoresha Ikinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa.

item3.q: Mba muri Diaspora. Ese nshobora kugisha inama umuvugizi ku bibazo by'ubutaka, izungura cyangwa ubucuruzi?
item3.a: Yego rwose. Ushobora kwishyura ukoresheje ikarita mpuzamahanga (Visa/Mastercard), guhitamo isaha ihuye n'aho uri, no guhura n'umuvugizi kuri videwo y'ibanga mugasuzuma icyemezo cy'ubutaka UPI n'amasezerano.

item4.q: Ese nkeneye gukuramo Zoom, Teams cyangwa indi porogaramu kugira ngo njye mu nama ya videwo?
item4.a: Oya rwose. Icyumba cyacu cy'inama gikora 100% muri porogaramu isanzwe usomeraho imbuga za interineti hifashishijwe LiveKit WebRTC. Ntibisaba gukuramo indi porogaramu kuri telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa.

item5.q: Ese umuvugizi ashobora kunkurikirana mu rukiko nyuma y'inama twagiranye kuri interineti?
item5.a: Yego cyane. Konsiltasiyo iba intambwe yo gusuzuma ikibazo. Iyo kigiye mu rukiko, umuvugizi aguha amasezerano yo kunganirwa (convention d'honoraires) n'inyandiko y'ububasha (procuration) yo kukuburanira mu nkiko z'u Rwanda binyuze muri IECMS.

item6.q: Ese abavugizi b'amategeko bakira bate amafaranga ya konsiltasiyo?
item6.a: Kwakira ubwishyu byikora kandi birizewe 100%. Iyo usoje inama ukanatanga incamake y'imyanzuro, amafaranga yari abitswe muri escrow ahita yoherezwa ako kanya kuri MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money cyangwa kuri banki yawe mu Rwanda.

item7.q: Ese umuvugizi agumana uburenganzira bwo kwishyiriraho ibiciro n'amasaha akoreraho?
item7.a: Yego cyane. Mu kubahiriza amahame y'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda, buri muvugizi yigenga mu gushyiraho ibiciro by'ubujyanama n'amasaha abonekeraho. MyJudicial ntigena ibiciro cyangwa ngo igutegeke uko ukora.

item8.q: Bagenzura bate ko umuvugizi ari umunyamuryango wemewe w'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi (RBA)?
item8.a: Buri muvugizi agenzurwa ko yanditse ku Rutonde rw'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda, akagenzurirwa uruhushya rwo gukora n'indangamuntu mbere y'uko konti ye yemezwa ku rubuga.

item9.q: Bigenda bite iyo umukiriya atitabiriye inama ku gihe mwapanze?
item9.a: Umwanya wawe urarinzwe. Iyo umukiriya ataje mu nama kandi atabimenyesheje nibura amasaha 24 mbere, amafaranga yari abitswe muri escrow ahabwa umuvugizi hakurikijwe amabwiriza yo guhagarika inama.

item10.q: Uburyo bwa escrow burinda bute amafaranga yanjye?
item10.a: Iyo wishe, amafaranga yawe abikwa kuri konti yizewe ya escrow. Umuvugizi yishyurwa gusa ari uko inama irangiye neza. Inama nihagarikwa cyangwa umuvugizi ntaze, amafaranga yawe uyasubizwa yose.

item11.q: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwishyura bwemewe kuri MyJudicial?
item11.a: Twemera MTN Mobile Money na Airtel Money ku bakiriya bo mu Rwanda, ndetse n'amakarita ya Visa na Mastercard ku bakiriya bo mu Rwanda no mu mahanga.

item12.q: Ese hari andi mafaranga y'inyongera cyangwa ay'uburiganya acibwa?
item12.a: Oya rwose. Igiciro ubona ku mwirondoro w'umuvugizi ni cyo cyonyine wishyura. Nta yandi mafaranga y'ubwishingizi cyangwa ay'ubufatabuguzi acibwa mu ibanga.

item13.q: Amabwiriza yo guhagarika inama no gusubizwa amafaranga ateye ate?
item13.a: Ushobora guhindura igihe cyangwa guhagarika inama ugasubizwa amafaranga yawe yose mbere y'amasaha 24 y'inama. Iyo umuvugizi atabonetse, umukiriya ahita asubizwa amafaranga ye 100% ako kanya.

item14.q: Ese abavugizi bose bari kuri MyJudicial bemewe n'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda?
item14.a: Yego. Buri muvugizi wese uri kuri MyJudicial agenzurwa ku Rutonde rw'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda (RBA). Ntidushobora kwemerera umuntu utemewe gutanga ubujyanama mu mategeko.

item15.q: Ese ibiganiro by'inama birafatwa mu majwi cyangwa amashusho na porogaramu?
item15.a: Oya rwose. Ntitwigera dufata amajwi cyangwa amashusho y'inama. Itumanaho ryose rikoresha ikoranabuhanga ry'ibanga rya WebRTC kugira ngo ibanga ry'umwuga w'amategeko ryubahirizwe 100%.

item16.q: MyJudicial yubahiriza ite Itegeko ry'u Rwanda No. 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite?
item16.a: Amakuru yose n'inyandiko zishyirwaho birindwa mu buryo bukomeye hakurikijwe Itegeko No. 058/2021. Umuvugizi wahisemo wenyine ni we ufite uburenganzira bwo kureba inyandiko z'ikibazo cyawe mu ibanga.

faqs.clientSubtitle: Ibintu byose ukwiye kumenya ku bijyanye no gutegura, gufata umwanya no kugisha inama umuvugizi.
faqs.advocateSubtitle: Ibintu byose abanyamwuga mu by'amategeko bakeneye kumenya ku bijyanye no gukora, kwakira amafaranga n'amahame y'umwuga.
faqs.clientQ1: Mba muri Diaspora (Amerika, Uburayi, EAC). Ese nshobora kugisha inama umuvugizi ku bibazo by'ubutaka cyangwa ubucuruzi mu Rwanda?
faqs.clientA1: Yego rwose. Abakiriya bacu benshi baba mu mahanga (diaspora). Ushobora kwishyura ukoresheje amakarita mpuzamahanga (Visa/Mastercard), guhitamo isaha ihuye n'isaha y'aho uherereye, no guhura n'umuvugizi binyuze kuri videwo yacu y'ibanga mugasuzuma icyemezo cy'ubutaka UPI, amasezerano y'ubucuruzi, cyangwa iby'izungura.
faqs.clientQ2: Abavugizi b'amategeko bakoresha izihe ndimi kuri MyJudicial?
faqs.clientA2: Abavugizi bose bari kuri MyJudicial bavuga nibura indimi ebyiri mu ndimi zemewe mu mategeko y'u Rwanda. Ushobora gushungura ugahitamo umuvugizi ukoresha Ikinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa, kugira ngo usobanure ikibazo cyawe mu rurimi wumva neza kurusha izindi.
faqs.clientQ3: Ese nkeneye gukuramo Zoom, Teams cyangwa indi porogaramu kugira ngo njye mu nama?
faqs.clientA3: Oya rwose. Icyumba cyacu cy'inama gikora 100% muri porogaramu isanzwe usomeraho imbuga za interineti (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) hifashishijwe LiveKit WebRTC. Ntibisaba gushyiramo porogaramu nshya cyangwa gufungura indi konti kuri telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa yawe.
faqs.clientQ4: Ese guhamagara kuri telefoni isanzwe bikora bite niba nta murandasi mfite?
faqs.clientA4: Niba wahisemo uburyo bwo guhamagarwa kuri telefoni (Phone Consultation), ntusabwa kugira murandasi. Ku isaha mwapanze, umuvugizi w'amategeko aguhamagara ako kanya kuri nimero yawe ya MTN cyangwa Airtel watanze ubwo wafataga umwanya.
faqs.clientQ5: Ese nshobora kohereza inyandiko z'ubutaka (UPI), amasezerano cyangwa impapuro z'urukiko mbere y'inama?
faqs.clientA5: Yego. Mu gihe wuzuza ibisabwa, ushobora gushyiraho inyandiko za PDF cyangwa amafoto y'ibyangombwa byawe mu buryo bw'ibanga rikomeye. Umuvugizi abisoma mbere y'uko inama itangira kugira ngo aze yiteguye neza aho gutakaza iminota y'inama asoma inyandiko.
faqs.clientQ6: Ese umuvugizi ashobora kunkurikirana mu rukiko nyuma y'inama twagiranye kuri interineti?
faqs.clientA6: Yego cyane. Konsiltasiyo ni yo ifungura amarembo yo kunganirwa mu buryo bwuzuye. Niba ikibazo cyawe kigomba kugezwa mu rukiko cyangwa kigakenera amasezerano akomeye, umuvugizi azaguha amasezerano yo kunganirwa (convention d'honoraires) n'inyandiko y'ububasha (procuration) yo kukuburanira mu nkiko z'u Rwanda binyuze muri IECMS.
faqs.advocateQ1: Ese abavugizi b'amategeko bakira bate amafaranga yishyuwe na ba mukiriya?
faqs.advocateA1: Kwakira ubwishyu byikora kandi birizewe 100%. Iyo usoje inama ukanatanga incamake y'imyanzuro, amafaranga yari abitswe muri escrow ahita yoherezwa ako kanya kuri MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money cyangwa kuri konti yawe ya banki mu Rwanda—nta birarane cyangwa gukurikirana umukiriya.
faqs.advocateQ2: Ese umuvugizi agumana uburenganzira bwo kwishyiriraho ibiciro n'amasaha akoreraho?
faqs.advocateA2: Yego cyane. Mu kubahiriza amahame y'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda, buri muvugizi yigenga mu gushyiraho ibiciro by'ubujyanama n'amasaha abonekeraho. MyJudicial ntigena ibiciro cyangwa ngo igutegeke uko ukora.
faqs.advocateQ3: Bagenzura bate ko umuvugizi ari umunyamuryango wemewe w'Urugaga (RBA)?
faqs.advocateA3: Buri muvugizi agen Cardano yanditse ku Rutonde rw'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda, akagenzurirwa uruhushya rwo gukora n'indangamuntu mbere y'uko konti ye yemezwa ku rubuga.
faqs.advocateQ4: Ese konsiltasiyo yo kuri murandasi ishobora kuvamo kunganira umukiriya mu nkiko z'u Rwanda?
faqs.advocateA4: Yego rwose. Konsiltasiyo iba intambwe yo gusuzuma ikibazo. Iyo kigiye mu nkiko cyangwa kigakenera amasezerano, mukora amasezerano yo kunganirwa (convention d'honoraires) n'inyandiko y'ububasha (procuration) ukamuburanira mu nkiko z'u Rwanda binyuze muri IECMS.
faqs.advocateQ5: Bigenda bite iyo umukiriya atitabiriye inama ku gihe mwapanze?
faqs.advocateA5: Umwanya wawe urarinzwe. Iyo umukiriya ataje mu nama kandi atabimenyesheje nibura amasaha 24 mbere, amafaranga yari abitswe muri escrow ahabwa umuvugizi hakurikijwe amabwiriza yo guhagarika inama.
faqs.advocateQ6: Umutekano n'ibanga ry'akazi by'umuvugizi birindwa bite kuri MyJudicial?
faqs.advocateA6: Itumanaho ryose rya videwo n'amajwi rikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya WebRTC rifite umutekano w'ibanga wa 256-bit nta muntu ubangikanya cyangwa ngo rifatwe amajwi. Amakuru y'amadosiye arindwa hakurikijwe Itegeko No. 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'amahame y'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi.

faqs.title: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa ku Biciro n'Ubwishyu
faqs.subtitle: Ibisubizo bisobanutse ku bijyanye n'amafaranga, ubwishyu, n'ubwirinzi bwacu.
faqs.q1: Ibiciro bya serivisi z'amategeko bigenwa gute?
faqs.a1: Buri mwavoka wemewe agena ku giti cye ibiciro bye bihamye kuri MyJudicial ashingiye ku bunararibonye bwe, ubuhanga mu mwuga, n'igihe cyo gutegura dosiye. Buri serivisi igira igihe n'intego bisobanutse neza.
faqs.q2: Ese nshobora kumenya igiciro nyacyo mbere yo gufata gahunda?
faqs.a2: Yego. Burigihe ubona igiciro cyose mu Mafaranga y'u Rwanda (RWF), igihe inama izamara, n'uburyo izakorwamo mbere yo kwemeza cyangwa kwishyura.
faqs.q3: Ni iki gikubiye mu giciro kigaragazwa?
faqs.a3: Igiciro kigaragazwa gikubiyemo igihe cyose cy'inama, gusuzuma inyandiko zatanzwe mbere, ihuza rishingiye ku mutekano (amashusho cyangwa telefoni), hamwe n'ubwirinzi bw'ubwishyu. Nta mafaranga y'inyongera yongerwaho mu kwishyura.
faqs.q4: Ese umwavoka ashobora guhindura igiciro nyuma yo gufata gahunda?
faqs.a4: Ntibyemewe na gato ku nama yamaze kwemezwa. Igiciro mwemeranyijweho kigomba kubahirizwa. Niba mwifuza gukomeza kumushyiraho mu manza z'urukiko cyangwa indi mirimo itandukanye, azaguha inyandiko y'ibiciro yihariye.
faqs.q5: Kwishyura ukoresheje Mobile Money mu Rwanda bikora gute?
faqs.a5: Dufatanyije na AzamPay itanga uburyo bwihuse bwo kwishyura bwa Mobile Money. Mu gihe cyo kwishyura, andika nimero yawe ya MTN (078/079) cyangwa Airtel (072/073). Uhita wakira ubutumwa (USSD) kuri telefoni yawe busaba gushyiramo umubare w'ibanga (PIN) kugira ngo wemeze ubwishyu.
faqs.q6: Ubwirinzi bw'ubwishyu (escrow) busobanura iki kuri MyJudicial?
faqs.a6: Bivuze ko amafaranga yawe adahita ahabwa umwavoka mbere y'igihe. Amafaranga arindirwa mu mutekano n'urubuga kugeza inama irangiye neza. Umwavoka ahabwa igihembo cye nyuma yo gusohoza inama.
faqs.q7: Bigenda bite iyo nifuza guhagarika gahunda cyangwa umwavoka ntiyitabire?
faqs.a7: Iyo umwavoka ahagaritse inama cyangwa ntiyitabire, uhita usubizwa 100% by'amafaranga yawe kuri konti yawe ya Mobile Money ako kanya. Ushobora kandi guhindura isaha y'inama n'umwavoka mbere y'uko igihe kigera nta bihano.
faqs.q8: Ese hari andi mafaranga yihishe cyangwa fagitire zitunguranye?
faqs.a8: Nta na make. MyJudicial ikuraho ibiciro bibarirwa ku masaha bitazwi iherezo, ingwate zidasobanutse, n'amafaranga y'inyongera mu kwishyura. Icyo ubonye ni cyo wishyura nta gihindutse.
